title: Default Arguments
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of default arguments using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Default Arguments** as part of **Functions and Parameters**. Apply default arguments by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Providing Default Values, Overriding Defaults, Reducing Unnecessary Overloads—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.
